items.author: 2ndplaceart.bsky.social
items.context: I do not have Adhd, but I have a "Cannot be beaten" collection of games on steam in order to help me beat my backlog of games with some kind of end to them. And yet Slay the Spire still calls to me... Great game... the problem is me.
items.text: Slay the Spire is easy to justify when you have a backlog, since a run is fairly short and you can stop at any point. Good luck with the plan!

items.author: biguruz.bsky.social
items.context: That is my favourite of the quest series. Carry that save file through all five games? Mind blowing. So glad it came to gog
items.text: Carrying the same character through all five games is a great touch. Bonus: GOG copies are DRM-free, so you can keep the installer and play offline.
items.verify: Проверьте, что в посте речь про Quest for Glory (сохранение переходит через 5 игр) и что серия есть на GOG.
